FAQ.TITLE: Frequently asked questions
FAQ.SUBTITLE: Find answers to the most common questions about Fluxnote and its features.
FAQ.Q1: How does AI work in Fluxnote?
FAQ.A1: The Fluxnote AI Assistant helps you improve your writing directly inside the document. You can generate content, get improvement suggestions, and request automatic summaries — all without leaving the editor.
FAQ.Q2: How many people can collaborate on a document at the same time?
FAQ.A2: All plans support real-time collaboration. The Free plan is suited for individual use, while Student, Pro, and Team plans unlock full team collaboration with role-based access control.
FAQ.Q3: Is my data safe in Fluxnote?
FAQ.A3: Yes — security is a core concern. Documents are private by default and only accessible to you and the people you explicitly grant access to. Permissions are managed per-document and per-team.
FAQ.A4: Every change to a document is automatically saved. You can view the full version history, compare any two versions side by side, and restore a previous version at any time.
FAQ.Q5: How do I cancel my subscription?
FAQ.A5: You can cancel anytime from your account settings under Subscriptions. You'll keep access to premium features until the end of your billing period.
FAQ.Q6: What types of documents can I create?
FAQ.A6: Fluxnote supports any kind of text document — reports, academic papers, project proposals, meeting notes, and more. The rich text editor supports formatting, headings, lists, and inline comments.
FAQ.A7: Teams have two roles: Owner and Team Admin. Within each document, members can be assigned as Editor or Viewer. Owners and Team Admins have full access to all team documents by default.
FAQ.NOT_FOUND: Didn't find the answer you were looking for?

HELP.TITLE: How can we help you?
HELP.SUBTITLE: Search our knowledge base or browse categories below
HELP.FAQ_SUBTITLE: Find answers to the most common questions about using Fluxnote.
HELP.STILL_HELP_DESC: Our support team is available 24/7 to assist you with any questions or issues.
HELP.CAT_AI_DESC: Leverage AI to enhance your work
HELP.FAQ_Q1: How do I create and share a document?
HELP.FAQ_A1: Create a document from the Dashboard by clicking the "New Document" button. Once inside the editor, click "Share" to generate an invite link with a role (Viewer or Editor) and expiration date.
HELP.FAQ_A2: Fluxnote saves a new version of your document automatically each time you close an editing session. Open the "History" panel inside the editor to browse, compare and restore previous versions.
HELP.FAQ_Q3: How do I collaborate in real time?
HELP.FAQ_A3: Any user with Editor access can open the same document simultaneously. Changes are synced live — you will see collaborators' names highlighted as you edit.
HELP.FAQ_Q4: How do I use the AI features?
HELP.FAQ_A4: Inside any document, open the "AI Assistance" panel to generate content or get a summary. Select text and click "Improve with AI" to receive improvement suggestions for that specific passage.
HELP.FAQ_Q5: How are teams and permissions organised?
HELP.FAQ_A5: Create a team and invite members with Owner, Team Admin or Member roles. Inside a team’s detail page, you can also configure per-document permissions (Viewer or Editor) for individual members.
HELP.FAQ_Q6: What file types can I use as AI context?
HELP.FAQ_A6: You can upload PDF or TXT files as context for the AI assistant. These files are used to ground AI-generated content in your own materials and help the AI produce more relevant results.
HELP.FAQ_Q7: How do I delete a document, and can I restore it?
HELP.FAQ_A7: To delete a document, open the options menu on the document card in the Dashboard and select 'Delete'. The document is moved to Trash. From the Trash section in the left sidebar, you can restore it at any time or permanently delete it.
HELP.FAQ_Q8: Can I organise documents into folders?
HELP.FAQ_A8: Yes — in the Dashboard or inside a Team's detail page, use the 'New Folder' button to create a folder. You can group existing documents together to keep your workspace organised by project or topic.
HELP.FAQ_Q9: What is the difference between Owner, Team Admin, and Member?
HELP.FAQ_A9: Owner has full control over the team, including the ability to delete it. Team Admin can add and remove members, manage roles, and has Editor access on all team documents they belong to. Member has access only to the documents they have been explicitly assigned to.
HELP.FAQ_Q10: How do I invite someone to collaborate on a document?
HELP.FAQ_A10: Open the document in the editor and click 'Share'. You can generate an invite link with a chosen permission level (Viewer or Editor) and an expiration date, or invite someone directly by email. The invited person must have a Fluxnote account.
HELP.FAQ_Q11: How do I compare two versions of a document?
HELP.FAQ_A11: Open the 'History' panel inside the document editor, select two versions, and click 'Compare Selected Versions'. You can switch between a unified diff view and a side-by-side view to see exactly what was added, modified, or removed.
HELP.FAQ_A12: Select any text in the editor and use the comment button to add a comment. Other members with access can reply and mark comments as resolved when addressed. All comments are visible in the Comments panel, and resolved ones can be reopened at any time.
HELP.FAQ_Q13: How do I change the interface language or theme?
HELP.FAQ_A13: Go to Settings from the left sidebar. Under 'Language', switch between English and Portuguese. Under 'Theme', choose Light, Dark, or Auto (which follows your system preference). Changes take effect immediately.
HELP.FAQ_Q14: How do I update my profile or change my password?
HELP.FAQ_A14: Go to Profile from the left sidebar to update your name, username, bio, and timezone. To change your password, scroll to the Security section and enter your current and new password. Note that username changes are limited per month.

ABOUT.TITLE: About Fluxnote
ABOUT.SUBTITLE: A collaborative document platform built by three software engineering students to eliminate the chaos of version conflicts and fragmented teamwork.
ABOUT.MISSION_P1: Fluxnote was born from a simple frustration: working in teams means juggling multiple document versions, merge conflicts, and constant coordination overhead.
ABOUT.MISSION_P2: Our goal is to provide a single shared space where teams can write, edit and collaborate in real time — with AI assistance built directly into the workflow, and granular permissions that keep everyone in control.
ABOUT.VALUES_SUBTITLE: These principles guide every decision — from architecture choices to user experience.
ABOUT.V1_DESC: Real teamwork means everyone contributes to the same source of truth — no more emailing files back and forth.
ABOUT.V2_DESC: Powerful features should not come at the cost of usability. We keep the experience clean and intuitive.
ABOUT.V3_DESC: Granular permissions and role-based access mean teams stay in control of who sees and edits what.
ABOUT.V4_DESC: AI should feel like a natural extension of writing — not a separate tool you have to switch to.
ABOUT.TEAM_SUBTITLE: Group 6 — Software Engineering 2025/2026, Escola Superior de Tecnologia de Setúbal.
ABOUT.MIGUEL_DESC: Responsible for planning, coordination and ensuring the project stays on track throughout each sprint.
ABOUT.RUBEN_DESC: Facilitates Agile ceremonies, removes blockers and keeps the team aligned with Scrum best practices.
ABOUT.RICARDO_DESC: Focused on building and delivering the core features of the platform across frontend and backend.
ABOUT.JOURNEY_SUBTITLE: From the first idea to a working platform.
ABOUT.M1_DESC: Fluxnote started as a project for the Software Engineering course (2025/2026) at EST Setúbal. Requirements gathered, tech stack defined, and first backlog created.
ABOUT.M2_DESC: System architecture, business processes, data model and UI mockups fully documented. Foundation laid for development sprints.
ABOUT.M3_DESC: Core features live: document editor, team management, role-based permissions, comments, version history and AI Assistant integration.
ABOUT.CTA_SUBTITLE: Create your free account and start collaborating with your team in minutes.
